Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal.data

Class PropertyStore.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.internal.data.PropertyStore.Builder
Enclosing class:
PropertyStore
public static final class PropertyStore.Builder extends Object
Collects property values per version. Data that is not network data (the behaviour properties of the Script API capture) comes in through put(org.geysermc.paletter.internal.data.PropertyStore.Owner, java.lang.String, org.geysermc.paletter.property.PropertyKind, java.lang.String, org.geysermc.paletter.data.DataVersion, java.lang.Object).

  • Method Details

    • put

      public @NonNull PropertyStore.Builder put(@NonNull PropertyStore.Owner owner, @NonNull String identifier, @NonNull PropertyKind kind, @NonNull String name, @NonNull DataVersion version, @NonNull Object value)
      Sets one property of an item or block in one version. This is the entry for property producers: the network data comes in through PropertyStore.build(java.util.List<org.geysermc.paletter.internal.data.VanillaData>), behaviour properties (friction, destroy time) are put here by the Script API capture.
      Parameters:
      owner - whether the identifier is an item or a block
      identifier - the item or block identifier
      kind - the kind of property
      name - the property name within its kind
      version - the version the value is valid in
      value - the value, an NBT tag value
